spans.text: Have we crushed her firewalls?
No... I don't want to put that on... I don't want to forget everything...!
I'm a failure... Instead of living as such...please just kill me!
It hurts! Please, let me go! I don't want this to go on!
I can't... I can't hear anything... I can't see anything...
What is she talking about...?
No, wait. Is this...her memory?
It feels like...I'm disappearing...
The pain...also disappearing...
My consciousness...slipping away...
Father...do you still need me?
I can hear her voice, but it's intermittent. Is there interference?
Is someone talking to me?
Who is it? Are you here to save me?
Or have you come...to replace me?
It's alright, you'll be fine.
You simply haven't been chosen because you aren't perfect.
That voice!
I knew right from the start that I wouldn't be chosen...
In that case, just let me disappear. Don't let me turn into a monster...
That voice...is replacing me...
It...is tormenting me...
Why? Father...you don't want me, do you?
You ARE wanted. So long as we're together...
No...you're consuming me...
If I can't remain myself, then let me die!
If I can't remain myself, then let me die!
If I can't remain myself, then let me die!
I can't allow that. You're wanted.
Hey, are you trying to take over her neural cloud?
Just like how you tricked me and locked me on Level III?!
That isn't me.
It's just one of its memory fragments.
But that voice...and even the tone are totally yours!
I knew it... You're a liar!
Even if that wasn't you, it doesn't change the fact that you've done something like this before!
Like you, this is the first time I've ever encountered it. I don't know what happened to it in the past.
As you said, this definitely has something to do with us...
And the conclusion I've drawn...is that you cannot be trusted!
If I can't remain myself, then let me die!
If I can't remain myself, then let me die!
If I...
I am...Nyto...
Unauthorized signal traffic detected.
Initiating Tier 1 Security Loop Mode.
Illegitimate neural cloud signal detected.
Initiating attack.
Crap. Was I discovered even with Lunasia's signal as disguise?
Tsk... We're about to get hit by a massive torrent. Our enemy is not to be underestimated.
It's a bit of a shame to just destroy you, but I can't let you cause any harm to Lunasia's neural cloud!
That voice seems to be tangled up in the offensive firewalls on Level II!
If I take this opportunity and sever the connection with her on Level II, I might be able to leave the consciousness in the system over there!
Lunasia, what are you doing?!
I'm sorry...
And goodbye!
Have I finally returned to the surface?
You're back?!
Tell me, what took you so long?
M4A1 turned around and looked at ST AR-15. The entire room was littered with white unit corpses. ST AR-15 was shoving a girl clad in black away from her.
Dammit... These things are way too tenacious... Did you fry them all on Level II?
I think...she did it in the end?
What?
...Hold on, you're...M4?
Y-yes...
Thank goodness.
What about the consciousness?
I've regained control over my body.
While we were in these unknown enemies' central system, I left Level II and severed the connection when the consciousness was busy wrestling with the enemies.
Good for you... It must've been tough.
What should we do now?
I've used up all my ammo, and it's starting to get dark...
What...? We've returned to the original theater in such a short period of time?
A short period of time?
How long have I been away?
Starting from when you started acting odd, it's been almost a whole day.
Holy...
We found shelter in a house and waited out a blizzard, then we came back to the theater.
We found a place where Ange had been, and these unidentified white enemies appeared out of nowhere.
Just now, the consciousness said she was going to hack into their network, but several hours had gone by and nothing happened.
Then they found our location and launched an attack immediately.
I barely managed to repel them with my remaining ammo and explosives, but then this black thing again sprang up out of nowhere.
It seemed to be equipped with some kind of shield – my ammo couldn't get through at all.
I had no choice but to cut off its head with my knife, but it was a lot stronger than I expected!
Thank goodness it suddenly stopped moving when things got really dicey!
Sorry for putting you through all that...
I've never seen you so rattled...
You'd also be this rattled if you had to face so many enemies all by yourself! I couldn't even leave you behind and just run for it!
Sorry...
Whatever. It wasn't your fault.
You said you were in their system. Got any ideas?
My neural cloud does contain the relevant records, so the consciousness was actually successful in her search for information about these enemies.
Hold on, let me analyze the records...
...Right, I've figured out their current locations, I would say...
What's the situation?
This is really bad...
These white units are extremely vast in number and they've already set up an encirclement around the outskirts of the city.
According to the communications logs, the main bulk of Griffin's troops have already withdrawn by choppers.
Tsk... Then what should we do?
Ange should still be somewhere near the city; I can deduce her rough location from the information I have, and she seems to have put up quite a fight.
Judging by the her inferred location, the Military didn't manage to trap her in their encirclement, but the only opening is in the other direction from where we are.
So we'll have to go around to the opening in their line of defense?
The Military are constantly shifting their positions. If we run into them, we're in no shape to fight.
Then what do you propose?
Ange must be trying to break through the encirclement. We still have a chance to regroup with her.
Plan A – we move together to evade the Military forces, then rendezvous at the extraction point.
Plan B – we inform her of our location and situation before she leaves, and she might be able to arrange for someone to come and pick us up.
However, whichever plan we decide to go with, establishing contact with her is still the prerequisite.
I just hope we won't have to resort to Plan B.
I can't bear to stay a minute longer in this freaking place.
There's a civilian signal tower in the outskirts of the city. We may be able to boost our signal and get in touch with Ange.
Is it far from here?
It's a fair bit of distance, and we'll have to cross a Military-controlled zone.
Things just keep getting worse and worse... I hope Ange can stay alive long enough to receive our signal.
